messages:
anika: Quick report — node samplekit helper returns an array after a tool retry in jsonMode, causing schema validator to fail. Repro is small and reliable.
anika: Steps: call tool with jsonMode, transient 401 triggers retry, transport replays buffered frame -> helper returns [obj] instead of obj. Validator expects object.

anika: Log snippet:
```ntransport: frame = {"id":1}
retry -> replay frame
assembly -> [ {"id":1} ]
validator: expected OBJECT got ARRAY
```
sanjay: Which sdk version?
anika: node-sdk@1.10.2 samplekit adapter. Python helper returns object in same case.
maria: Looks like assembler treats multiple frames as array and doesn't collapse single-length arrays. Parity gap.
leo: Short-term fix: collapse single-element arrays to object when jsonMode + expected schema is OBJECT. Also add strictJsonMode opt to refuse coercion.
maria: I'll add unit tests simulating a retry replay and a parity test comparing Node/Py under the same mocked transport.

leo: I'll open a small PR to normalize assembly and include verbose assembly logging behind debug flag for easier triage.
devex-bot: Ticket DX-1189 created: "node: JSON mode assembly returns array on retry -> schema fail". Labels: dx, parity, flaky-onboard.
anika: Attaching tiny repro (recorded frames + minimal harness) to the ticket. This blocked a demo, would appreciate a hotfix.
sanjay: Also adding a CI fuzz job that runs both SDKs against randomized chunk/retry sequences to catch this class of bugs.
maria: Good plan. We'll keep node sample marked in onboarding docs until patched.
anika: Thanks all :thumbsup:
